notes: The key test (Test every key, and the safety check every 6 pieces) now listens for any clear sound right after each key is struck, instead of its exact in-tune pitch, so a piano that is out of tune passes; a key that makes no sound, or one stuck down, still fails. The power plug: if it was set up in the Shelly app, the pairing screen now shows how to reset it so the tablet can take it over (in the Shelly app, Factory reset; or hold its button 10 seconds within a minute of plugging it in). The tablet also turns the plug's Matter off, which stops Android's "Matter device found" pop-up and closes a way to keep the 24 V on with no time limit.
